name: move-out is rejected on a VACANT unit
title: SC-08-07-01 move-out is rejected on a VACANT unit
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a unit in state VACANT
When the Site Manager requests move-out
Then the request is rejected and the unit remains in state VACANT
And no occupancy or ownership row is inserted or modified
